tier.description: Null when the sample is too small to rate the agent fairly.
tier.title: Tier

id.description: Database id, for linking straight to the call.
id.title: Id

rejected_attribution_notes.description: Broker attributions discarded because their evidence did not check out.
rejected_attribution_notes.title: Rejected Attribution Notes

rejected_marker_notes.description: Observations discarded because their evidence did not check out.
rejected_marker_notes.title: Rejected Marker Notes

provider.description: Provider name. Defaults to the configured provider.
provider.title: Provider

transcript.description: Pasted transcript, one speaker turn per line as 'Speaker: text'.
transcript.title: Transcript

discarded.description: Attributions naming this broker that failed evidence checking and were never recorded. Not included in the signal counts.
discarded.title: Discarded

CallSort.description:
A column the calls list may be ordered by.

An allowlist, not a column name passed through: the value arrives from a
query string, and mapping it to a column here is what stops it reaching SQL.
CallSort.title: CallSort

by_outcome.description: Always in the same order, worst last, so a category's segments do not shuffle when its mix changes. Zero-minute outcomes are kept.
by_outcome.title: By Outcome

ground_truth_kept.description: Always true. Ground truth is hand-labelled and cannot be regenerated by re-analysis, so it is never part of a clear.
ground_truth_kept.title: Ground Truth Kept

runs.description: Corpus run records removed, with their items.
runs.title: Runs

ComponentStatus.description: Outcome of probing a single component.
ComponentStatus.title: ComponentStatus

location.description: Where the corpus is read from.
location.title: Location

upper.description: Exclusive upper bound in minutes; null for the final open-ended band. Half-open like the score bins, so '10-20' holds 10 up to 19.
upper.title: Upper

identified_members.description: Members whose identifier was stated in the call. Calls without one are excluded rather than grouped, since unknown members are different people.
identified_members.title: Identified Members

long_call_count.description: Calls at or beyond twice the median, which is where 'long' starts.
long_call_count.title: Long Call Count

median_minutes_to_answer.description: Median minutes a member spent across all their calls before one of them resolved their issue. Members still waiting are excluded, not counted as zero.
median_minutes_to_answer.title: Median Minutes To Answer

members_with_answer.description: Identified members who reached a resolution. The population the time-to-answer figure is measured over.
members_with_answer.title: Members With Answer

members_without_answer.description: Identified members with no resolved call. Their clock has not stopped, so folding them in would shorten the reported time the longer they are left waiting.
members_without_answer.title: Members Without Answer

repeat_contact_rate.description: Share of identified members who called more than once, as a percentage.
repeat_contact_rate.title: Repeat Contact Rate

score_gap.description: Points the slower half scores above the faster half. Positive is the direction an average-handle-time target makes worse.
score_gap.title: Score Gap

is_thin.description: Too few calls in this hour to read anything into.
is_thin.title: Is Thin

factors.description: Machine-readable risk factor codes observed for this member.
factors.title: Factors

member_name.description: The member's name where a call stated one. Null otherwise — the identifier is always known, the name is not.
member_name.title: Member Name

basis.default: Observed warning signs, not a prediction. Ranked by how many signs a member shows. No weighting has been validated against real churn.
basis.description: What this list is. Stated on the response because a client must not present it as a prediction: no factor here has been measured against an actual departure.
basis.title: Basis

first_contact_resolution_rate.description: RESOLVED as a percentage of all calls. Excludes PARTIALLY RESOLVED.
first_contact_resolution_rate.title: First Contact Resolution Rate

mean_score.description: Reported alongside the median because the distribution is bimodal; one number alone would hide the low cluster.
mean_score.title: Mean Score

taxonomy_coverage.description: Share of calls landing in a defined category. Below 90% means the taxonomy needs revising, not the chart.
taxonomy_coverage.title: Taxonomy Coverage

billable.description: Whether running against this provider is charged for per token.
billable.title: Billable

configured.description: Whether the provider's required settings are present.
configured.title: Configured

implemented.description: False for providers registered but not built.
implemented.title: Implemented

local.description: Whether transcripts stay inside this environment. False means calls are sent to a third party, which is a statement about member health conversations rather than about cost.
local.title: Local

reachable.description: Whether it answered a probe just now.
reachable.title: Reachable

selectable.description: Whether an analysis may be run against it.
selectable.title: Selectable

categories.description: Slowest first. Every configured category appears, including those that have resolved nothing.
categories.title: Categories

resolved_calls.description: Calls that reached a resolution. Every figure here is measured over these only — handle time across all calls rewards ending the call, not solving it.
resolved_calls.title: Resolved Calls

categories.description: Every configured L4 category, including those with no signals — the absence is shown rather than implied.
categories.title: Categories

acknowledge_cost.description: Required to run against a provider that charges per token.
acknowledge_cost.title: Acknowledge Cost

force.description: Re-analyse calls that already have an analysis, replacing them.
force.title: Force

provider.description: Provider name. Defaults to the configured provider.
provider.title: Provider

categories.description: Most time first. Categories with no timed calls are omitted.
categories.title: Categories

fast_fail.description: Ended without an answer in less time than a typical successful call — a member brushed off. A coaching signal.

productive_share.description: Share of all minutes spent on calls that reached a resolution.
productive_share.title: Productive Share

resolved_median_minutes.description: Median duration of a resolved call, and the line dividing the two failure modes. Derived from the corpus, not configured.
resolved_median_minutes.title: Resolved Median Minutes

slow_fail.description: Ended without an answer having taken at least as long as a typical successful call — the work was done and the system had no answer. A process signal, and coaching these agents would be the wrong response.

TrendDeltaResponse.description: The most recent week against the one before it.
TrendDeltaResponse.title: TrendDeltaResponse

median_score.description: Absent for a week with no calls, which is a gap not a zero.
median_score.title: Median Score
